title: Small-coefficient constant realization commutes with perfect scalar extension
statement: Let X be a scheme and q : A → B a homomorphism of commutative rings in the scheme universe. For a perfect algebraic derived A-module P (one represented by a bounded complex of finite projective modules) [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], exact constant realization with its prescribed coefficient-universe lift commutes, up to isomorphism, with algebraic derived scalar extension along q and derived sheaf scalar extension along the actual constant coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data, def-sfb-module-derived-scalar-comparisons, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. This requires neither an adic datum nor a nonempty chart.

source.place: Tag 093J (constant modules and tensor); sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY and 0D6D (K-flat computation and scalar transitivity).

proof.text: Choose a bounded finite-projective complex representing P. It is K-flat, so the canonical algebraic representative map computes derived extension termwise. Its coefficient-universe lift remains bounded and termwise flat, hence K-flat.

The tensor universal property identifies the lift of B tensor_A M with ULift B tensor_ULift A ULift M. On pure tensors send up(b tensor m) to up(b) tensor up(m). This is linear over ULift B, is natural in M, and commutes with differentials. Localize this natural complex isomorphism and use the K-flat representative maps on both sides.

Factor the exact small constant realization into coefficient lift followed by the large constant realization. Identify the completed sheaf scalar extension with the standard constant scalar extension by uniqueness of their common derived restriction adjoint. Apply the proved large constant scalar-extension comparison, insert the lifted algebraic comparison, and transport along the perfect representative isomorphism.

theorem finitePerfectAdicConstant_scalarExtension
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A B : Type t} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (q : A →+* B)
    (P : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} A)) (hP : DerivedCategory.IsPerfect P) :
    Nonempty
      ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (adicConstantMap X q)).obj
          ((finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X A).obj P) ≅
        (finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X B).obj
          ((ConstantScalarRealization.moduleDerivedExtension q).obj P))
